title: Welcome to Lanternwake
bpm: 104 (swing 0.05; held breath bar 37, rit. in coda)
sections: Intro(0-9s) A(9-46s) B(46-83s) Break(83-86s) A'(86-123s) Coda(123-140s incl. ring-out)
instruments: celesta (lead), section pizzicato (bass + offbeat chords), flute (B tune, A' doubling), bassoon-like reed counter-line (A'), harp, strings pad, woodblock/shaker
motif_notes: Establishes the Lanternwake motif: Bb4 F5 E5 F5 G5 D5 (1 5 #4 5 6 3; 8th 8th 16th 16th 8th qtr). A: motif + answer phrases, sequenced on D, minor-iv (Ebm6) shadow; B: new legato flute tune in G minor; coda tosses the motif low pizz -> celesta (on Ebm) -> high celesta, pizzicato 'ta-da' button.
location_playlist: hallowmere_safe: Lanternwake Commons / regional safe areas (rotate with m16)
review: Re-measured, unchanged. Quiet pizzicato intro (~-24 LUFS short-term, ~6 LU under A) is deliberate.

title: Copper Leaves at Dusk
key: A major (B: F# minor, C: F major)
instruments: warm section strings (viola-register lead), musette (bellows reed; B tune and A'' counter-line), harp 6/8 rolls and 3/4 hemiola chords, low strings canon, celesta, plucked bass, frame drum/shaker/tambourine
motif_notes: Own tune (not the Lanternwake motif): a lilting rising sixth E4-A4-C#5 that falls back by step; B is a hemiola musette dance (2+2+2 against 6/8); C is a loose canon (free imitation) on the tune's opening between low strings and celesta in F major (bVI), turning back via Bbm6 -> E7.
location_playlist: hallowmere_explore: Hallowmere travel / festival outskirts (rotate with m15)
review: Section C sustained sine bass lowered 4 dB (was the loudest bus there, ~37 % of the section's energy below 120 Hz). C is now ~-19.5 LUFS short-term.

title: Pumpkin Patch Parade
bpm: 96 (light shuffle 0.1), small rit. on the last bars
instruments: bassoon-like reed (lead / oom-pah), marimba (backbeat chords, arpeggios, tune in A'), warm strings (B tune, pads), plucked bass, little clacks (claves), woodblock, soft parade drum, shaker
motif_notes: Own tune: a bouncing staccato arpeggio C-E-G-E answered by legato steps, with a comic minor-iv sigh (A-C-Ab-F) in bar 6. B: lyrical A-minor string tune (no drum). A' swaps roles (marimba tune, reed oom-pah).
review: Section B sustained sine bass lowered 4 dB (it out-weighed the string tune; B had -5.7 dB of energy below 120 Hz vs -14.6 dB in A).

title: Stone Bells, Quiet Hills
key: E Dorian / E minor (B section C major), ends on E major
sections: Intro(0-11s) A(11-57s) B(57-92s) Interlude(92-104s) A'(104-138s) Coda(138-154s incl. ring-out)
instruments: low wire-and-wood plucks (measured quarter notes), warm horn pair (theme), warm strings, stone bells (tierce bell) and small struck-metal tings, timpani, pad, soft bass
motif_notes: Own theme: a rising fourth B3-E4 that climbs by broad steps to B4 over Em-D-A/C#-C-G/B-Bm (the C# gives the Dorian colour). B: strings climb through C-G/B-Am7 to a high C6. Interlude: bells only. Coda: Picardy E major with a last bell.
review: Re-measured, unchanged. Quiet intro (~-24 LUFS short-term) is deliberate.

title: Candles for the Moon
key: A minor (B: F major colour with Ab / Fm6), ends on A major add9
sections: Intro(0-11s) A(11-55s) B(55-88s) A'(88-121s) Coda(121-145s incl. ring-out)
instruments: glass harmonica (lullaby lead), airy wordless choir pad ('oo'/'oh'/'ah' vowel formants only, no consonants = no intelligible words), harp rocking accompaniment, bowed low strings, rare harp-harmonic flickers
motif_notes: Own lullaby: a rocking falling triad E5-C5-A4 answered by a turn around B4, cadencing on the leading tone G#4; B: choir sings a slower tune through F-Dm7-Bbmaj7-C-Ab-Fm6-E7 (the Ab/Fm6 are the eerie shadows); A' adds a low 'oo' shadow; coda resolves to A major.
review: Choir buses get a broad dip at 330 Hz (pad -5 dB, lead -3 dB, Q 1.6) and the pad +2 dB: the 'oo' formant plus the held E4 common tone made one steady 315 Hz band 9-15 dB above its neighbours. Choir stays dark ('oo'); the intro is still dominated by the held E4.

title: Every Road Leads Home
bpm: 112, broadening to 56 on the final chord
key: G major, lifts to A major for A' and the coda
sections: Intro(0-9s) A(9-43s) B(43-77s) Bridge(77-86s) A'(86-120s) Coda(120-146s incl. ring-out)
instruments: flute (festival tune), clarinet (haven motif), celesta, warm strings, horn pair (bridge), harp strum/arpeggios, pizzicato + soft bass, marimba offbeats, tambourine, soft drum, shaker, woodblock, timpani
motif_notes: Combines the Lanternwake motif (from m15; 1 5 #4 5 6 3, e.g. G4 D5 C#5 D5 E5 B4) and the HAVEN motif (first bar of HAVEN_A in music_tracks.py: D5 G5 F#5 E5 D5 B4). Intro: they greet each other; A: new festival tune grown from the Lanternwake motif; B: haven motif on clarinet over new harmony, celesta answers with Lanternwake; bridge: motif climbs G-Em-F on horns to A major; A': both motifs in counterpoint (Lanternwake rising in the flute, haven falling in the clarinet); NEW coda D-Dm6-A/E-E7-F#m-D-E7-A with a broad final cadence.
